channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Ferry Landing
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Ferry Landing (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA's April 28, 2026 post calls it "a new $77.1 million ferry landing" and records a $4.5 million Prop L allocation; SFCTA's June 2024 program shows a total project cost of $82,450,000. The two totals are not reconciled. The Port's undated page lists Phase 2b as "in progress" and Phase 2a marine demolition as complete (2025); completion of the landing is expected by the end of 2027.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The Mission Bay Ferry Landing page no longer says the redevelopment-area boundary contains the landing. The two landing shapes drawn from the City's 2018 plan lie just outside DataSF's Mission Bay South boundary, a few metres from it at the nearest corner.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The ferry landing now sits at its designed position, with the separate water taxi landing the City reviews with it as one project. Both follow the City's 2018 plan, not as-built drawings, and nothing was built there in the August 2025 imagery. The outline is still approximate.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: This page said no source places the ferry landing at the former Pier 64. The City's 2018 environmental review does: it says the project area is at Pier 64, called "Pier 64½" in the Port's Waterfront Land Use Plan documents.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The City's environmental review names two Assessor lots for the ferry landing project, 9900064 and 9900064H. This record had said no lot exists. The landings drawn on the map are the 2018 design and mostly lie outside those lots' outlines, so the map is unchanged.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: SFCTA Board approves $4.5M in Prop L sales-tax funds toward what SFCTA calls "a new $77.1 million ferry landing" (its share of $9.8M approved for three projects; approved April 14, final approval April 28, 2026). This is a funding allocation, not a construction cost; SFCTA's June 2024 five-year program gives a different total project cost of $82,450,000 (see open questions). (Apr 2026)

item.title: Expected · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: Completion of the ferry landing is expected by the end of 2027. (~2027)

item.title: Complete · Mission Bay Ferry Landing: The Port's project page lists "2025 Phase 2a Marine Demolition and Mattress (complete)" (the page is undated, so the completion date is not known; SFCTA, April 28, 2026, describes the earlier work as "the removal of former Pier 64 and other underwater preparatory work"). (~2025)
